name: Sōma (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sōma city emblem in red: a stylised device of two curved horns above a ring with a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Sōma, a city in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 December 1962.

features.role: Sōma city emblem — a stylised device of two curved horns above a ring with a small disc
